label: Dubstep / Tearout (Metallic, Aggressive)
tempo_line: Tempo as written 140-150 BPM, felt half-time 70-75 BPM
tempo_note: Tempo is written the sourced dubstep way: 140 BPM, felt half-time as 70 (drumstep: about 172-174, felt 86-87). The official melodic dubstep cards say 171 for the same kind of music. Compare by ear before trusting either.
note: Studio-authored recipe, not an official Music 3 template, untested (nothing has been rendered from it yet).

cards.mood: A cinematic, orchestral-style dark intro with a low brass-like swell and a ticking percussion pattern breaks into a violent first drop. A breakdown returns to eerie atmosphere with an ominous chord, then a second drop switches the bass…
cards.vocal: No lead singer. Low, spoken-style fragments and distorted, wordless vocal textures act as sound effects in the intro and between the drops.
cards.palette: Percussive gun-like bass stabs and machine-gun triplet runs, made from FM synthesis with heavy waveshaping, drive both drops, with a long screeching lead sliding between phrases over a clean mono sub.
cards.tempo_line: written 150 BPM, felt half-time as 75 BPM

cards.mood: Tense and mechanical, it opens with a dry metallic loop and a rising siren, then a single heavy hit leads into a bouncing, grinding drop. The riff is rebuilt every eight bars with a new timbre, a mid-section drops to a bare sub and snare,…
cards.vocal: No lead singer. Short, clipped vocal one-shots, such as hype shouts and single words, are cut into the build-ups as rhythmic punctuation.
cards.palette: A grinding mid-bass riff with comb-filter movement and bit-crushing alternates with a short, snapping percussive bass hit, both layered over a controlled sub and repeating in tight two-bar phrases.
cards.tempo_line: written 140 BPM, felt half-time as 70 BPM

cards.mood: Aggressive from the first bar: a shouted intro line over a bare metallic beat, a pre-chorus that tightens with snare rolls and a barrage-like drop where the voice trades phrases with the bass. A bridge leaves only a dark chord and the…
cards.vocal: Singer A (Male). The vocalist possesses a gritty, mid-range tenor timbre with a raw, urgent edge.
cards.palette: Heavily distorted, FM-style mid-bass stabs answer each shouted line in the drops, with a screeching lead above and a clean mono sub below.
cards.tempo_line: written 150 BPM, felt half-time as 75 BPM
